Before technique comes understanding.

A free introduction to Baby Boom's pediatric pathway and the foundational concepts behind the certification training. An easy starting point before moving into the paid catalogue.

This is the pre-watch for the Pediatric Bootcamp & P.I.P.S.™ Technique Certification: the recorded sessions, so live attendees arrive aligned in language, neurology and clinical thinking.

What you will watch

Three recorded parts, completed at your pace.

Part 1

Building Blocks

Pediatrics, Neuro 101 and the ABC of Pediatric Practice

Before technique comes understanding. This foundational module reorients your clinical thinking around brain development, neuroplasticity, stress physiology and early adaptation.

  • How fetal and infant brain development shapes lifelong patterns
  • Epigenetics and environmental influence
  • Serve-and-return and attachment neuroscience
  • The power of touch and somatosensory regulation
  • The 4 T's: Traumas, Thoughts, Toxins, Technology
  • The posture, airway and tongue relationship
  • Developmental milestones without rushing to label
  • Creating a pediatric practice environment families trust
Part 2

Pediatric Bootcamp

Structural Mastery from Infancy to Adolescence

This immersive intensive trains you to assess and integrate pediatric care at a high clinical level.

  • Complete pediatric history and neurological examination
  • Tonal and cranial assessment
  • Primitive reflex evaluation and integration strategies
  • Pediatric TMJD understanding
  • Postural compensation patterns
  • Adolescent neurological development
  • Case integration and care plan design
Part 3

P.I.P.S.™ Technique

Pediatric Intraoral Palate Specific Technique

You will learn how oral dysfunction influences posture, breathing, primitive reflexes, vagal tone and neurodevelopment, and how to address it safely, precisely and within scope.

  • Identify tongue-tie, lip-tie, oral tension and oral dysfunction, beyond the obvious signs
  • Recognize subtle compensation patterns linked to tongue posture and oral tone
  • Assess and address pediatric TMJD and intraoral palate imbalances
  • Link oral dysfunction to posture, primitive reflexes, breathing mechanics and vagal tone
  • Apply specific intraoral and cranial techniques safely across age ranges
  • Integrate the top home exercises to decrease tension, improve function and reduce recurrence
  • Communicate and collaborate with dentists, IBCLCs, SLPs, pediatricians and other providers

Enrollment

Free, and required before attending a live course. Experienced practitioners can go straight to the catalogue.

Free Start free

Who is eligible

Building Blocks (Part 1) is open to a broader range of regulated providers, including IBCLCs and SLPs.

The Pediatric Bootcamp and P.I.P.S.™ Certification itself is open to regulated healthcare providers whose scope includes pediatric hands-on assessment.

Taught by

Dr. Jenna Davis

Family chiropractor, international speaker and educator based in Oakville, Ontario, and the creator of the P.I.P.S.™ Technique.
